jobs_results.title: Certification Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
About Us

Always open. Our code, our culture, our opportunities. Leading open innovation without limits. We are SUSE.

SUSE is a global leader in innovative, reliable and secure enterprise open source solutions, including SUSE Linux Enterprise (SLE), Rancher and NeuVector. More than 60% of the Fortune 500 rely on SUSE to power their mission-critical workloads, enabling them to innovate everywhere – from the data center to the cloud, to the edge and beyond. SUSE puts the “open” back in open source, collaborating with partners and communities to give customers the agility to tackle innovation challenges today and the freedom to evolve their strategy and solutions tomorrow.

We are open in our roots and open in our approach, striving to be the most trusted open innovator in the World. Openness extends beyond our technology. Our vibrant community thrives on diversity and connectivity without borders.
Certification Project Manager

Job Description

As a Certification Project Manager, you... will have the opportunity to meaningfully impact how our organization scales by attaining certification compliance of SUSE products portfolio in accordance with industry production standards in security and conformance defined by worldwide established bodies such as ISO, NIST, BSI, PCI, as well as other national certification bodies. Join industry-leading professionals to ensure that our processes, infrastructure, and products are designed, operated, maintained and protected in accordance with these certifications and security standards as it applies to SUSE. This role reports to SUSE’s Head of Solutions Certification and will work closely with Engineering, Product Management, Legal, Pre-Sales and Marketing.

Summary:

You are responsible for establishing and persistently maintaining certified production compliance status for portfolio of chosen SUSE products and their relevant certifications. You drive the design and implementation of corresponding compliance frameworks, define delivery milestones and track their progress.

Responsibilities:
• Driving certification cycles projects for our enterprise products and organization
• Defining milestones and tracking their progress
• Liaising common grounds across Engineering, PM, consultants, and partners
• Coordinating compliance requirements across different teams
• Organizing events and workshops necessary for relevant knowledge sharing
• Organizing cycle process documentation and keeping it in accurate up to date state
• Communicating with certification labs and authorities, primarily in Germany and the US
• Filing and tracking relevant application paperwork
• Communication with external and internal customers

Candidate Profile:
• 5+ years of total experience in software product development industry
• Minimum 1 year of which in managing product and organization certification compliance to security, conformance, or safety standards from ISO, CCRA / Common Criteria, NIST / FIPS or other standardisation bodies
• Strong skills in process handling and documentation frameworks, such as MS/Open/Libre Office, Confluence/Jira, etc
• Good knowledge about certification bodies (e.g. BSI, NIST, NIAP, ANSSI) and their typical requirements
• Passion for organized paperwork and skills of keeping large sets of information pieces in systematic manner
• Project management level in GPM/PMP/IPMA (minimal ‘D’, ‘C’ or ‘B’ is a plus) or equivalent
• Excellent communication and 'soft' skills
• Excellent communication level of English (German language skills is a plus)
• Familiarity with Linux operating system

What makes us different:
• You will find and can connect to highly skilled engineers at SUSE
• We provide many different products and endless opportunities to learn
• We help our employees to develop
• We work with, support, maintain, and advocate open-source!
• You can work with and within an international team
• Our working hours are as flexible as can be any team-work from home!
• We organize regular events (hackathons, workshops, outdoor events, etc) to build up relationships and friendship within and across teams
• At SUSE the opinion of the employee matters!
• SUSE is a growing company, with great products, a culture that fosters openness and friendship, and where many opportunities exist
• SUSE has more than two decades of experience in maintaining industrial grade security and bespoke product compliance to make our products outstanding

If you are successful for this position you'll have to pass pre-employment checks before joining us. The content of these checks may vary by country.

Job
Quality

What We Offer

We empower you to be bold, driving your career to create the future you want. We celebrate and reward your achievements. 

SUSE is a dynamic environment that is evolving rapidly, thus requiring agility, strong entrepreneurship and an open mind.

This is a compelling opportunity for the right person to join us as we continue to scale and prosper.  

If you’re a big thinker, obsessed by execution and thrive in a dynamic environment in which you can tangibly create a lasting legacy, then please apply now! 

We give you the freedom to be yourself. You will work in a global community of unique individuals – like you – with different backgrounds, talents, skills and perspectives. A truly open community where everyone is welcome, has a voice and is encouraged to reach their full potential regardless of age, gender, race, nationality, disability, sexual orientation, religion, or any other characteristics.  

Sounds like the right fit for you? Click Apply to submit your resume. A recruiter will contact you if your skills match our current or any future positions. In the meantime, stay updated on the latest SUSE news and job vacancies by joining our Talent Community.

SUSE Values
• We are passionate about customers 
• We are respectful and inclusive 
• We are empowered and accountable  
• We are trustworthy and act with integrity 
• We are collaborative 
• We are SUSE

jobs_results.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Job Purpose and Overview

The PMO at Appfire is the enterprise program management office and functions as the primary learning hub for the entire organization. We are the knowledge repository for ensuring the successful delivery of projects, aligning our efforts with the strategic goals of the organization. Beyond project management, we acknowledge the significance of managing change during project implementations to facilitate seamless transitions. As the central learning hub for Appfire, our PMO is dedicated to promoting continuous improvement and knowledge sharing throughout the organization. This commitment involves offering resources, training, and support to empower teams in their project pursuits, ultimately enhancing the overall capabilities of the organization.

Appfire is seeking to hire a Technical Project Manager within the PMO team to help advance and improve upon a high-value enterprise Program Management Office (ePMO). The ePMO will be a center of excellence for program... and organizational change management practices, driving the execution of a varied portfolio of high-profile programs and projects.

In the role of Technical Project Manager, you will report to the Sr. Manager of Program Management and be responsible for managing the successful and on-time delivery of compliance, security, IT operations, and enterprise initiatives that are driven by or significantly impacting one or more functional teams. You will collaborate with team managers to ensure the appropriate allocation and usage of resources for each project and ensure project stakeholders are kept informed about project progress and impediments.

What You Will Do:
• Serve as a primary point of contact for project teams.
• Lead and manage multiple concurrent midsize to large, complex projects from inception to close, including planning, scheduling, scope definition, identifying dependencies, identifying risks and creating a mitigation plan, facilitating issue resolution, and managing escalations.
• Develop detailed work plans, schedules, project estimates, resource plans, and status reports.
• Ensure and promote adherence to the ePMO methodology while also selecting the most appropriate framework for each assigned initiative.
• Ensure the scope of work for projects is defined, maintained, and actively updated, minimizing scope creep, tracking variance, communicating clearly to stakeholders, and facilitating change requests to manage budget or schedule impacts.
• Collaborate, manage workflows, and drive meetings between involved teams and team members to ensure all deliverables are completed on time, and within budget.
• Track team progress toward milestones, outcomes or deliverables, using key performance metrics to objectively identify project progress and health status.
• Provide ongoing communication to sponsor and stakeholders to manage expectations and keep them informed about progress and impediments.
• Review project deliverables to ensure they meet requirements and quality standards.
• Drive process and tooling improvements to increase throughput and output quality.
• Participate in setting best practices for project management principles for the PMO, and identify process improvement opportunities helping teams to be more efficient.

What We Would Like to See:
• 4+ years of experience with proven track record leading and managing projects end-to-end in a waterfall project management methodology. Additional experience with hybrid and agile are a bonus.
• Experience leading and managing security, compliance, IT operations, and/or enterprise projects.
• High attention to detail and proven ability to manage multiple competing priorities and projects at the same time.
• Familiarity with Confluence, Jira, Monday.com is a definite plus.
• Experience with Mergers and Acquisitions is highly desired.
• Track record of successful collaboration with cross-functional and distributed teams across the globe with the ability to work with different time zones.
• Strong time management skills to prioritize and manage one's own and others’ time efficiently, including meeting target dates and not overlooking any tasks or issues that need to be addressed.
• Ability to translate complex tasks into executable, sequential, and measurable actions.
• Proven ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels and communicate clearly and concisely.
• Ability to foster collaborative relationships with other cross-functional teams.
• Excellent written and oral communication skills in English, including spelling and grammar.
• Ability to communicate quickly and concisely (verbal and written) with management on technical issues in non-technical terms.

What We Offer:
• Every Appfire employee is eligible for company equity
• Remote work flexibility from home office
• Private health insurance
• 25 working day of paid annual leave
• Reduced summer hours: From July 1st until the end of August we work 6 hours per day.
• Flexible bank holidays policy: Allowing you to exchange a government-set public holiday for a more convenient time off.
• Annual sport allowance

#LI-Remote

jobs_results.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Crossover is the world's #1 source of full-time remote jobs. Our clients offer top-tier pay for top-tier talent. We're recruiting this role for our client, Trilogy. Have you got what it takes?

We're looking for an experienced technical product lead to turn high-level goals and milestones into actionable engineering work, for our strategic line of products:
• Crossover: An AI-powered hiring platform that sifts through millions of applicants per year to find the top 1% of global remote talent. We're breaking down geographical barriers and making high-paying jobs accessible to professionals worldwide, regardless of their location.
• gt.school: An online education platform that uses advanced data collection, algorithms, and AI-generated content to empower students to learn at their own pace. Our adaptive learning system fills knowledge gaps, accelerates learning, and helps students master a whole grade level on a subject within weeks.
• Data-driven Sales: This initiative leverages data... and AI algorithms to streamline the sales process across a portfolio of over 100 software products. We're transitioning these products to a unified platform based on Salesforce and NetSuite, all while handling complex data imports, synchronization, modeling divergences and data inconsistencies.

What we offer:
• The opportunity to learn and experiment with using generative AI to boost your productivity.
• A team of exceptionally talented product people and engineers from around the world as your peers.
• The chance to work on products that are reshaping industries and making a difference in people's lives.

We're not just using AI as a buzzword. We're at the start of a thrilling journey with generative AI, experimenting and learning to fully leverage its potential and free our product people and engineers from mundane tasks, allowing them to focus on what truly matters: design, decision-making, and understanding the far-reaching implications of different implementation strategies.

If you’re passionate about designing and delivering high-quality software, we'd love to hear from you.

What you will be doing
• Breaking down high-level milestones into requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria
• Iterating with our designers to transform use cases and user stories into functional UX/UI prototypes
• Taking any important technical decisions you feel strongly about (e.g., data model, 3rd-party patterns to use)
• Reviewing and accepting engineering deliverables, ensuring it meets all of your requirements

What you won’t be doing
• Chasing developers to get their work and tasks delivered on time
• Managing people or completing HR & administrative tasks
• Performing low-level exhaustive quality assurance work

Technical Product Owner key responsibilities
• Create high-quality software releases by leveraging engineering talent
• Ensure the engineering deliverables snap together well and fully implement the milestone
• Imagine how users will interact with a product and develop robust use cases

Basic Requirements
• At least 3 years of hands-on experience working as a software engineer.
• Knowledge of relational database fundamentals and hands-on experience writing SQL.
• Experience defining product/technical requirements and peer reviewing/accepting engineering deliverables.
• An openness to learn to heavily use generative A.I. in your day-to-day work.

Nice-to-have Requirements
• Experience in using generative A.I. in your day-to-day work (product or development).

About Trilogy

Hundreds of software businesses run on the Trilogy Business Platform. For three decades, Trilogy has been known for 3 things: Relentlessly seeking top talent, Innovating new technology, and incubating new businesses. Our technological innovation is spearheaded by a passion for simple customer-facing designs. Our incubation of new businesses ranges from entirely new moon-shot ideas to rearchitecting existing projects for today's modern cloud-based stack. Trilogy is a place where you can be surrounded with great people, be proud of doing great work, and grow your career by leaps and bounds

jobs_results.title: Global Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
This a Full Remote job, the offer is available from: India, Spain

Global Project Manager

Description -

Job scope/summary:
• As Partner and Footprint Project manager you will be part of the CS (Customer Support & Services) CCC (Customer Care Center) organization. Partner and Footprint management team is managing partner relationships for the network of delivery partners customer care centers over all the Globe. Objectives of the organization are to provide superior customer experience, rapidly adopt digital and automation, drive Services Revenue Growth and Sustainability.

We have the mission to support Delivery partner CCC on 3 pillars:
• Development & Management of CC partners to achieve an streamlined footprint, operational consistency and resilience while improving customer experience.
• Lead partners to propose and adopt the latest technologies to ensure effortless customer experience, simplified agent journey and cost optimization.
• Adopt New workforce models: Crowdsourcing... and Working from home enablement for outsource workforce. Define Ops excellence on work from home setup.

Your mission will be to lead innovative and transformational projects which may span across business models, footprint changes and efficiency improvements. You will work with regional and global teams, and external partners, in a highly multicultural and multi-country environment.

Job specifics/responsibilities:
• Provides direct and ongoing leadership for a team of individual contributors designing and developing and coordinating projects for partner delivery. Including, new business models, partner changes and efficiency improvements.
• Communicates project status and escalates issues to direct managers, program managers, and internal and external development partners.
• Manages relationships with outsourced partners, including setting expectations regarding deliverables, service quality, schedules, and costs
• Effective communication and collaboration with team members, outsourced resources, sponsors and partners
• Proactively identifies opportunities for process improvement and cost reductions opportunities.
• Lead projects from design to handover to operations.
• Robust Governance Structure
• Keep stakeholders informed and expectations management
• Deliver a solution that works for Operations.

Key deliverables/accountabilities:
• Project objectives being achieved: Savings, implementation dates, adhering to timeline
• Opportunities for efficiency in projects are identified and implemented

Education (degree) and professional experience required:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Process Engineering, Business Administration or equivalent diploma
• Experience working in a virtual team environment

Other requirements:
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including negotiation and influencing skills (Fluent in English is a must)

Personal skills and qualities:
• Familiar with HP Customer Care Center support environment.
• Good understanding of current setup.
• Operations and processes.
• Proven ability to work effectively in a multi-cultural, diverse, virtual global team.
• Strong personal relationship skills.
• Program management expertise and change management skills, ideally: PMP Certified. COPC certification is a plus
• Vendor Management knowledge.
• Proven ability to interact and drive topics to completion and to achieve results in a complex environment.
• Strong ability to collaborate and influence.
• Experience in working with Global Teams is a definite plus
• Seniority and standing, comfortable in interacting on executive level (internal & external).

Technical skills (procedures and documents the employee has to be acquainted with):
• MS Office
• Reporting tool /Data management

We’re looking for visionaries who are ready to make an impact on the way the world works. At HP, the future’s yours to create!

jobs_results.title: IT Project Manager Intern
jobs_results.description:
Roche fördert Diversität, Gleichstellung und Inklusion und repräsentiert die Gemeinschaften, denen wir dienen. Wenn es um die Gesundheitsversorgung auf globaler Ebene geht, ist Vielfalt eine wesentliche Zutat für den Erfolg. Wir glauben, dass Inklusion der Schlüssel zum Verständnis der unterschiedlichen Bedürfnisse der Menschen im Gesundheitsbereich ist. Gemeinsam engagieren wir uns für Individualität und teilen die Leidenschaft für eine herausragende Versorgung. Kommen Sie zu Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Die Position

Purpose of the role

A project manager is a professional responsible for overseeing and leading the execution of projects from initiation to completion. They are responsible for ensuring that projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in accordance with the project's objectives and requirement

How would your day to day look like?

You will play a fundamental role in the delivery of projects by facilitating communication, encouraging teamwork, and providing... guidance to team members to ensure they understand their tasks and deadlines.

Main responsibilities:
• Creating a comprehensive project plan, including defining project goals, objectives, scope, deliverables, and timelines.
• Identifying tasks, allocate resources, and create a schedule to ensure the project progresses smoothly.
• Overseeing the project team, assigning roles and responsibilities, and ensuring effective collaboration.
• Identifying project stakeholders, establish effective communication channels, and manage their expectations.
• Proactively identifying potential risks and develop strategies to mitigate or minimize their impact on the project. This includes conducting risk assessments, creating contingency plans, and monitoring risks throughout the project.
• Working with relevant stakeholders to define and manage the project budget. Monitor project costs, track expenses, and ensure that the project is delivered within the allocated budget.
• Developing and implement quality control processes, conduct quality reviews, and address any deficiencies to maintain high-quality outcomes.
• Monitoring project progress, track milestones, and report on the status to stakeholders.
• Providing regular updates on project performance, identify any deviations from the plan, and take corrective actions as needed.
• Assessing change requests, evaluating their impact on the project, and implementing approved changes while minimizing disruption.
• Maintaining project documentation, including project plans, reports, and communication records ensuring those are organized, up to date, and easily accessible to the project team and stakeholders.
• Overseeing the project closure process, including conducting post-project evaluations, documenting lessons learned, and archiving project documentation.

Who are you?
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science or a related field
• Proficient in English
• Good communication and interpersonal skills capable of maintaining strong relationships
• Strong organizational and multi-tasking skills
• Excellent analytical and problem solving abilities
• Team-management and leadership skills
• Documentation management and ability to use project management tools
• Attention to details even under pressure
• Time management skills with the ability to meet deadlines
• Work permit to work in Spain.
• A team player, who listens to their colleagues but is not afraid to share your own ideas.
• A proactive person and comfortable with speaking up constructively.
• Comfort with uncertainty.
• Looking for a purpose where your work will have a real impact in patient lives. Your work is meaningful to you.
• Not afraid to fail and learn
• Nice to have: IT Infrastructure background (Security, data management, data center scope...)

What do we offer?

A dynamic and collaborative work environment where you will have the opportunity to learn and grow in the field of Project Management. Access to various internal and external training platforms (e.g. Linkedin Learning). Experienced and professional colleagues and workplace that supports innovation. You will work with cutting-edge technologies

Wer wir sind

Bei Roche leisten 100,000 Menschen in 100 Ländern Pionierarbeit im Gesundheitswesen. Gemeinsam haben wir uns zu einem weltweit führenden, forschungsorientierten Healthcare-Konzern entwickelt. Unser Erfolg baut auf Innovation, Neugier und Vielfalt.

Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber, der die Chancengleichheit fördert

jobs_results.title: IT Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
¿Dónde vas a trabajar?

Multinational leader in the Retail Industry. Operating on a global scale, they have a substantial presence in Madrid.

¿Qué harás en tu nuevo puesto?

The role's mission is to support the business' direct-to-consumer strategy by leading IT projects and including retail, CRM, B2C and B2B areas, both from a technical and functional standpoint.

The successful candidate will join the team in a supportive and collaborative role with a focus and ownership of the applications belonging the direct-to-consumer area and will be responsible to optimize the business value delivered by projects and solutions, while promoting synergies & IT strategy of Group Technical Team and addressing the specificities and priorities of your scope.

Reporting to the Head of IT team, the IT Project Manager will have the following responsibilities:
Lead IT projects to support the business strategy and growth:
• Manage complex IT projects within the retail industry, ensuring timely... completion and meeting of objectives.
• Monitor the proper usage of the tools by the final user developing KPIs and sharing them with Business Key Users.
• Work with Business users to understand the business goals and propose solutions to improve processes, productivity, sales increase:

-Implement strategies for gathering, reviewing, and analyzing data requirements.

-Translate business requirements into functional and technical requirements.

-Prioritize requirements.

-Master strategic business process modelling, traceability, and quality management techniques
• Apply best practices for effective communication and problem-solving

Strengthen the partnership with your internal customers:
• Be the point of contact for the Group Technical Expertise Center and be its representative on your perimeter.
• Ensure the right IT investments for your perimeter:

-Quantify and track business performance data.

-Oversee and consolidate IT budgets and costs for your scope.
• Give directives on IT expenses optimization of your perimeter in complete transparency.
• Monitor all projects & services and report on their progress.
• Bring added value in innovation by being proactive and using creativity
• Understand complaints and pressure points on projects and services and suggest alternatives.
• Develop and implement surveys to know the satisfaction of internal customers.
• Ensure high quality service and performance monitoring through monthly governance with your pairs

Promote the services offered:
• Promote and sell relevant services within your perimeter, based on the service catalog:

-Help the branches to understand the added value of all these services.

-Propose and participate in the choice of technologies on projects.
• Collect needs and expectations to ensure the catalog's relevance and its enrichment.
• Contribute to create synergies between Brands, ensure the alignment of stakeholders, anticipate their needs, avoid out-of-process initiatives, and finally create maximum value based on the reuse of skills and experience.
• Work with the organization to ensure the consistency of the EMEA solutions with needs and participate.

¿A quién buscamos (H/M/D)?

A successful IT Project Manager should have:
• Bachelor's degree in management engineering or economics
• LANGUAGES: English (Fluent C1)
• Experience in project management within a technology environment.
• Excellent leadership and communication skills.
• Valuable understanding of the retail industry but opened to other sectors.
• Problem-solving abilities.
• Knowledge of the latest technology trends and their applications, valuable in ecommerce environment

¿Cuáles son tus beneficios?
• Competitive salary range of €50,000 - €55,000 per year.
• Additional 10% variable salary.
• Opportunity to work in a global company

jobs_results.title: API Technical  Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
AXA Group Operations is the IT solutions and business consulting provider of the AXA Group, one of the world's leading insurance and financial protection companies. We develop and operate transverse business solutions at international scale.

Working for the different companies of the AXA group, AXA Services has a worldwide action field with offices in 16 countries.

Our mission is to shape, build and maintain the shared solutions of AXA Group. The aim of these services is to sustain business development, reduce time to market, & generate savings.

Environment:

This resource will join a team of IT professionals involved in solution delivery and maintenance activities delivered by the API Management applicative team for the AXA Group.

Main tasks and responsibilities

· Do the scoping and manage technical projects (planning, workload, risks)

· Design APIs and provide high level support during UAT to the team (support user during their tests), ncluding defect management processes,

·... Ensure defined process is respected (change, defect, management).

· Deliver project documentation

· Develop APIs on webMethods when needed

· Review, check the quality and test APIs provided by developers

· Lead a small team (<5 persons)

· Manage Applicaitve BAU, Provide symptom check, critical situation analysis, recovery planning and implementation

· Single Point Of Contact for our client to adress all other teams (Platform, Operations) or sub product (moniotring, network, etc)

· Onboarding of junior members

· Ability to provide low level transversal knowledge between projects belonging to different companies inside our Group to increase the quality

Your Profile

Professional and technical skills

Technical Skills:

Experience: 3 to 5 years experience as Software AG/ web Methods developer and a first experience as project management

Must Have:

· First experience in technical project management to implement APIs using a Middleware

· REST and SOAP

· Knowledge on API gateways

Nice to Have:
• Broadcom Layer 7 experience
• webMethods experience
• Java development
• ELK knowledge

· Ability to travel / ability to be relocated for short periods in other countries.

Non-Technical Skills:
• Experience working alongside internal and external providers in an international context;
• Be required to work in professional cross teams environments, and at times, work autonomously;
• Communicating clearly, politely and respectfully in person, by telephone and in writing
• Explaining complex technical information simply
• Bringing people into conversations to ensure the right people are involved
• Knowing how to adapt to different people
• Degree in a relevant area, such as, Computer Science or similar education;
• Availability to work out of regular working hours if ocasionaly required;

Nice to have: Agility

Language

English: Independent user (C1 in Common European Framework of Reference for Languages)

Spanish: Independent user – it’s a plus

Portuguese: Independent user – it’s a plus

French: Independent user – it’s a plus

About AXA

As a world-leading insurance company, we act for human progress by protecting what matters. With 153,000 employees in 54 countries working with 105 million customers, we’ve created a truly dynamic and vibrant community. Inclusion and diversity link closely with our values, and together we’re nurturing a culture of
respect, for each other, for our customers and the communities around us. Join AXA and you’ll feel like you belong, are included and can thrive. You’ll be able to shape the way you work and truly grow your potential as you seek out new opportunities, push boundaries and benefit people in critical moments of their lives. This is your chance to build the tomorrow you want. Know you can.

About the Entity

AXA is becoming a sustainable tech-led company and at AXA Group Operations we are one of the major catalysts for this transformation.

We set the tone by triggering and empowering the evolution of our insurance business model through technology and innovation, driving its concrete implementation globally at speed, with a high quality of advisory and execution.

We are present across 17 countries with committed, highly qualified teams. We leverage technology, data, sourcing, security and investment allocation in a global way, but also achieve economies of scale and synergies when necessary.

At AXA Group Operations, we want to be recognized in three fields of action:
• State-of-the-art Data Technology to drive customer experience
• State-of-the-art Procurement & Sourcing to drive efficiency and better manage risks
• High-Performing Global Team for stronger partnerships with AXA entities

What We Offer

We bring together the expertise, cultural diversity and creativity of over 8,000 employees worldwide and we’re committed to equal opportunities in all aspects of employment (gender, LGBT+, disabled persons, or people of different origins) and to promoting Diversity & Inclusion by creating a work environment where all employees are treated with dignity and respect, and where individual differences are valued

jobs_results.title: Project Manager, People PMO
jobs_results.description:
Description

With Confluent, organisations can harness the full power of continuously flowing data to innovate and win in the modern digital world. We have a purpose that drives us to do better every day we're creating an entirely new category within data infrastructure - data streaming. This technology will allow every organisation to create experiences and use the power of data in ways that profoundly impact the way we all live. This impact is our purpose and drives us to do better every day.

One Confluent. One team. One Data Streaming Platform.

Data Connects Us.

About the Role

Confluent is looking for a functional Project Manager to act as a force-multiplier focused on increasing execution efficiency. Reporting to the Head of People Strategy and PMO, you'll serve as a centralized resource and partner closely with all of our People functions and other cross-functional stakeholders.

In this role you will provide support on projects and work streams focused on the People orgs... transformation, operational excellence and strategic improvements. As a 'go-to' person, you will be instrumental in guiding the seamless transition from big picture to details while navigating tight timelines. You will facilitate cohesive collaboration within and across organizations by providing operational discipline, identifying and mitigating dependencies and risks, and forging strong relationships through effective communication.

What You Will Do
• Drive planning processes by leading conversations with key stakeholders to develop concepts into defined deliverables and ensure execution reliability.
• Continuously improve and scale the People organization by sharing project frameworks, tools, and best practices that can be easily adopted to increase delivery efficiency.
• Lead and manage complex and large scale cross-team, cross-functional initiatives from inception through deployment including defining scope and execution milestones.
• Proactively evaluate and resolve obstacles and balance competing priorities through fluid communication with project stakeholders.
• Engage and energize project teams to achieve aggressive goals.
• Leverage general knowledge to conduct simple analyses and establish performance metrics.
• Solicit and evaluate feedback to determine appropriate actions, solutions and initiatives needed.
• Create and deliver clear and detailed documentation and presentations for complex projects.

What You Will Bring
• Strong project management skills and ability to manage competing priorities without losing sight of the most important initiatives.
• Practical working knowledge and experience in human resources with at least one full deployment project leveraging key HR systems (e.g. HCM/HRIS, LMS, ATS, etc.).
• Demonstrable experience in analyzing business needs and aligning them to project execution and KPIs.
• Exceptional interpersonal skills to be able to influentially drive alignment among stakeholders while ensuring execution accountability across teams.
• Deductive problem solving for moderate to highly complex problems; some limited data analysis may be required.
• Proven ability to clearly document and articulate goals, requirements, timelines, resources and risk within and across cross-functional teams.

What Gives You an Edge
• Experience with Workday
• Exposure to Tableau
• PMP certification(s)
• Experience working in high growth public company setting

Come As You Are

At Confluent, equality is a core tenet of our culture. We are committed to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. The more diverse we are, the richer our community and the broader our impact. Employment decisions are made on the basis of job-related criteria without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other classification protected by applicable law.

Click HERE to review our Candidate Privacy Notice which describes how and when Confluent, Inc., and its group companies, collects, uses, and shares certain personal information of California job applicants and prospective employees.

Reporting to the Head of People Strategy and PMO, you'll serve as a centralized resource and partner closely with all of our People functions and other cross-functional stakeholders.

In this role you will provide support on projects and work streams focused on the People orgs... transformation, operational excellence and strategic improvements. As a 'go-to' person, you will be instrumental in guiding the seamless transition from big picture to details while navigating tight timelines. You will facilitate cohesive collaboration within and across organizations by providing operational discipline, identifying and mitigating dependencies and risks, and forging strong relationships through effective communication.

What You Will Do
• Drive planning processes by leading conversations with key stakeholders to develop concepts into defined deliverables and ensure execution reliability.
• Continuously improve and scale the People organization by sharing project frameworks, tools, and best practices that can be easily adopted to increase delivery efficiency.
• Lead and manage complex and large scale cross-team, cross-functional initiatives from inception through deployment including defining scope and execution milestones.
• Proactively evaluate and resolve obstacles and balance competing priorities through fluid communication with project stakeholders.
• Engage and energize project teams to achieve aggressive goals.
• Leverage general knowledge to conduct simple analyses and establish performance metrics.
• Solicit and evaluate feedback to determine appropriate actions, solutions and initiatives needed.
• Create and deliver clear and detailed documentation and presentations for complex projects.

What You Will Bring
• Strong project management skills and ability to manage competing priorities without losing sight of the most important initiatives.
• Practical working knowledge and experience in human resources with at least one full deployment project leveraging key HR systems (e.g. HCM/HRIS, LMS, ATS, etc.).
• Demonstrable experience in analyzing business needs and aligning them to project execution and KPIs.
• Exceptional interpersonal skills to be able to influentially drive alignment among stakeholders while ensuring execution accountability across teams.
• Deductive problem solving for moderate to highly complex problems; some limited data analysis may be required.
• Proven ability to clearly document and articulate goals, requirements, timelines, resources and risk within and across cross-functional teams.

What Gives You an Edge
• Experience with Workday
• Exposure to Tableau
• PMP certification(s)
• Experience working in high growth public company setting

Come As You Are

At Confluent, equality is a core tenet of our culture. We are committed to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. The more diverse we are, the richer our community and the broader our impact. Employment decisions are made on the basis of job-related criteria without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other classification protected by applicable law.

jobs_results.title: IT Portfolio Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
At LOEWE, we are looking for an exceptionally organized IT Portfolio Project Manager to join our innovative team. As the go-to for the IT Portfolio, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining a comprehensive IT Portfolio that meets the business needs of the company.The ideal candidate should have exceptional organizational skills, experience in project management and IT portfolio management, knowledge of IT project management processes and methodology, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. You should also have excellent communication and interpersonal skills.At LOEWE, we are looking for an individual who is passionate about their work, has a strong work ethic, and is an innovative problem-solver who is not afraid to take initiative. If you think you have what it takes to hit the ground running in this role and are excited to join a team of passionate professionals, we’d love to hear from you.

Responsibilities:

Develop and maintain a... comprehensive IT Portfolio that meets the business needs of the company.
Create and/or maintain project management processes and methodology.
Monitor progress of project deliverables and make adjustments as needed.
Establish and manage relationships with stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
Monitor IT portfolio performance and make necessary changes to ensure alignment with business goals and objectives.
Identify and assess risks associated with IT projects and develop strategies to mitigate those risks.
Prepare and deliver presentations and reports on IT portfolio performance.
Liaise with vendors to ensure successful delivery of IT projects.
Develop and implement best practices for IT portfolio management.
Stay abreast of the latest trends and technologies in the IT industry.

LOEWE is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics
